name: Perseus Digital Library — canonical-greekLit (TEI XML)
acquisition: GitHub tarball pinned to resolved commit SHA (scripts/fetch/perseus_greeklit.sh); TEI body-text extraction at ingest
notes: README: 'Unless otherwise indicated, all contents ... are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License' (verified 2026-07-06). Per-file exceptions possible — ingest honors per-file availability statements and keeps TEI text body only (apparatus handled separately). Curated scholarly digitization.

name: Open Greek and Latin — First1KGreek (TEI XML)
era: classical to late-antique, incl. patristic/Byzantine-era authors (polytonic)
acquisition: GitHub tarball pinned to resolved commit SHA (scripts/fetch/first1k_greek.sh)
notes: SPDX CC-BY-SA-4.0 via GitHub license API (verified 2026-07-06). Digitization method not stated in-repo -> conservatively treated as OCR-derived-with-correction: tier-2, capped at <=35% of greek_poly, lexicon-anomaly batch audit at ingest.

name: Project Gutenberg — Greek-language ebooks
acquisition: pg_catalog.csv filtered to language=el, then per-id .txt.utf-8 with rate limit (scripts/fetch/gutenberg_el.sh)
notes: 'The vast majority of Project Gutenberg eBooks are in the public domain in the US'; redistribution allowed 'with or without' the trademark (verified 2026-07-06). Human-keyed (Distributed Proofreaders). Strip PG header/footer + transcriber notes; per-book script profiling splits poly vs mono; fetch UTF-8 variants only (legacy ISO-8859-7 files exist).

name: Greek Wikisource (elwikisource)
era: ancient to modern; strong 19c katharevousa stratum
notes: Dumps legal page: textual content GFDL + CC-BY-SA 4.0 (verified 2026-07-06). Human-typed transcriptions; prefer ProofreadPage-validated pages where status is present. Old-law subset counts toward the legal-register cap.

name: Greek Wikipedia (elwiki)
notes: Primary NATURAL code-switch mine: Greek prose with mid-line Latin names/titles/citations. Wiki markup stripped at ingest; reference register capped <=40% of greek_mono.

name: Greek Wikinews (elwikinews)
acquisition: Wikimedia dump elwikinews-latest-pages-articles.xml.bz2 — small, fetched by default (scripts/fetch/wikinews_el.sh)
notes: Dumps legal page: Wikinews text CC-BY 2.5 (pre-2005-09-25 content PD). Small but supplies the press register.

name: EUR-Lex / Cellar — EU law and Official Journal in Greek
acquisition: Cellar REST content negotiation + SPARQL (publications.europa.eu/webapi/rdf/sparql); stub fetches sample CELEX docs in EL (scripts/fetch/eurlex_el.sh)
notes: Commission legal notice: EU-owned content 'licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence', policy via Decision 2011/833/EU (verified 2026-07-06; eur-lex.europa.eu's own notice page is JS-rendered and returned blank to fetch). Born-digital. HARD CAP: legal+parliamentary <=15% of Greek-base lines.

name: Europarl v7 parallel corpus (statmt.org)
acquisition: v7 tarballs: el-en.tgz (145MB) + fr/de/it/es-en pairs, gated (scripts/fetch/europarl_v7.sh)
notes: 'We are not aware of any copyright restrictions of the material' (verified 2026-07-06); EP proceedings, official human translations. Greek side 1.5M sentences. Counts toward the legal/parliamentary register cap.

name: Project Gutenberg — en/fr/de/it/es ebooks
acquisition: pg_catalog.csv filtered to langs en,fr,de,it,es; capped per-lang harvest (scripts/fetch/gutenberg_latin.sh)
notes: Human-keyed (Distributed Proofreaders). en dominates raw supply — draw at en .40 / fr .20 / de .20 / it .10 / es .10. Strip PG boilerplate.

name: Wikipedia slices — en/fr/de/it/es
notes: Oversupply — draw a thin slice per language; same per-lang mix as gutenberg_latin.

name: arXiv descriptive metadata (titles + abstracts + authors)
acquisition: OAI-PMH harvest (export.arxiv.org/oai2, oai_dc), resumption-token loop gated (scripts/fetch/arxiv_meta.sh)
notes: 'You are free to use descriptive metadata about arXiv e-prints under ... CC0 1.0'; abstracts are part of that metadata (verified 2026-07-06). Author-keyed. Gate LaTeX residue ($..$, backslash-commands). Titles also seed code-switch splicing.

name: Project Gutenberg — Russian-language ebooks
notes: Human-keyed. Pre-reform orthography (ѣ, ѳ, ѵ, і-in-Russian) is not in codec v1 -> such lines auto-reject at encode, accounted per contract; prefer modernized editions.

name: Wikisource ru + uk
notes: Human-proofread transcriptions. Draw ru .75 / uk .25. Pre-reform Russian pages reject at codec as above.

name: Crossref bibliographic metadata (REST API / public data file)
license: facts / no-license per Crossref policy (abstracts EXCLUDED)
acquisition: REST sample calls with mailto etiquette; annual public data file for bulk (scripts/fetch/crossref_meta.sh)
notes: Crossref: bibliographic metadata are facts not subject to copyright, 'you may use it for any purpose'; abstracts may carry third-party copyright -> NEVER ingested (verified 2026-07-06 via crossref.org; the docs URL intermittently 404s to plain fetch). Seeds author-title-journal-year citation templates for cs synthesis.

name: OpenCitations Meta / Index
notes: 'Creative Commons public domain dedication (CC0)' for citation data and bibliographic metadata (verified 2026-07-06). Cleanest citation-seed lane; complements crossref_meta.

name: Estia newspaper (polytonic contemporary press)
license: site content — OWNER-RATIFIED for training use (2026-07-06, rendering-content only)
notes: 87.6% polytonic (glossapi script_profile, n=80k sample 2026-07-06); born-digital; rights ruling: owner accepts as-is (2026-07-06)

name: Greek Parliament digital library (proceedings 1843->)
acquisition: rsync from home-ts + scripts/extract/homets_lines.py --greek-strict --doc-accept-floor 0.85 --doc-strict-floor 0.9 --min-doc-lines 30 (best-scanned-docs gate + no non-Greek letters)
notes: 91.5% polytonic (n=200k sample); library text layer likely OCR-derived for old volumes -> lexicon audit; pdf_cache 107 PDFs = layout-distillation + appearance-band + real-crop-eval pool; quality lane 2026-07-06: greek-strict line filter (non-Greek LETTERS = OCR misreads, rejected) + per-doc scan-quality ranking (--doc-report)
